highlights.title: Nepal floods: Search operations enter 12th day
highlights.summary:
Nepali rescuers faced challenging conditions on Sunday as search operations following catastrophic floods entered their 12th day, buoyed by the extraordinary rescue of four survivors.
 
The disaster has also affected infrastructure and roads. Our correspondent Shahzaib Wahlah tells us more.
